site.title: How this site works
site.intro: This site is its own case study. No magic, just decisions you can poke at:

items.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React Three Fiber: the hero suslik is thousands of particles in a single draw call, morphing into persona glyphs and scattering away from your finger. Custom shader, zero prebuilt 3D assets.
items.hub: The backend is suslicke-hub: FastAPI + an aiogram bot on my own VPS. The shirt QR points at /qr, and I change campaigns and config straight from Telegram.
items.fallback: An nginx fallback: if the hub goes down, nginx answers with the redirect itself, so the shirt QR can't die as long as nginx is alive.
items.counter: The visit counter is my own Postgres table, no cookies: a daily hash instead of tracking. PostHog runs only with consent.
